title: 150W Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Panel Kit with 12V Battery, Charge Controller, and 200W Inverter, for RV, Boat, Off-Grid Systems
description: This 150W Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Panel Kit is a comprehensive off-grid power solution that includes everything you need to harness solar energy efficiently. The kit comes complete with a 12V deep-cycle battery, a solar charge controller with an easy-to-read LCD display, and a 200W Big Power inverter, making it ideal for RVs, boats, caravans, and remote off-grid installations. The solar panel measures 1490mm x 665mm x 30mm and is built with a sturdy aluminium frame for long-lasting durability. The included charge controller intelligently regulates the charging process to protect your battery, while the 200W 12V DC converter ensures reliable power output for your appliances. The wiring diagram included makes setup straightforward even for first-time users. Whether you are looking to power lights, small appliances, or charge devices in a remote location, this all-in-one solar kit delivers a dependable and self-sufficient energy solution. Please refer to the product images for detailed wiring and installation guidance.
